title: Optimize Startup Process
body:
The current startup process requires manually executing multiple commands:

1. `cp .env.example .env.local`
2. `pnpm dlx auth secret`
3. `pnpm start`

This method can be error-prone or less user-friendly. A streamlined, one-click solution would significantly improve the developer experience.
I plan to submit a PR to address this issue. :smile:
author: codersjj

comments.body:
Hi, @codersjj. PR is welcome!

But we don't restrict users to any specific package manager.

So if you want to make something, please consider that it should be compatible with npm, pnpm, yarn, etc. ;-)
